title: AI Glossary Quiz
oneLiner: Ten questions drawn from the AI and machine learning terms in the Glossary: tokens, embeddings, RAG, LoRA, quantization and the rest.
keyTakeaway: Most AI jargon is a short name for one idea from this section. If you can tell a token from an embedding, fine-tuning from RAG, and temperature from top-p, you can follow nearly any conversation about AI tools.
explanation:
The terms live in the Glossary section under "AI and machine learning", so you can also search them there and add them to your Flash Cards. This quiz draws only from that topic, and every wrong option is another AI term, so you cannot rule options out because they are about something else.

Pick a direction, answer ten questions, and review the definitions of any you missed. Terms that have a lesson in this section link back to it.
